semanticReview.summary: Every finish route requires a selected clue and a child-written, revised draft. The parent rubric checks the situation, narrator, and characters rather than treating completion as writing-quality success.

gameplayReview.summary: The chosen source sentence and original draft remain visible together; the child can change the clue and revise before visiting the archive. Completion requires a draft and revision, while writing quality remains for parent review.

inspect_location.childAction: Investigate a selected location and retain the discovery.
inspect_location.evidence: Investigation history only; reading assessment still needs the actual evidence selection or artifact.
inspect_location.visibleChange: Authoritative discovery state can reveal actual passages, tools or contextual materials.

move_actor.childAction: Move the selected actor through an adjacent usable connection.
move_actor.evidence: Navigation and choice history only; an arrival is never evidence of conceptual understanding.
move_actor.visibleChange: The actor travels between actual locations; conceptual state can make a connection usable or blocked.

replace_text.evidence: Text artifact and process, assessed against a parent rubric.

revise_text.evidence: Actual revision and parent-assessed writing quality.
revise_text.visibleChange: Previous and new drafts differ; future events retain both.

select_evidence.childAction: Place a passage sentence on the board.
select_evidence.evidence: Selection key; factual support still needs semantic review.
select_evidence.visibleChange: The selected literal sentence becomes the displayed clue.

renderer.accessibility: Keyboard and touch buttons, responsive scrolling/layout and reduced-motion support
renderer.animation: Accepted world movement animates left/top; reduced motion disables animation
renderer.consequences: Server-derived from authoritative post-action state, with zero rule cascades
renderer.gestures: Native keyboard/click selection and location targets; drag for movable entities
renderer.mainSurface: A spatial world stage with actionable locations/entities/connections

physicalSurfaces.anchors: Bounded clear-lane placement prefers declared route midpoint/location anchors, then avoids full artifact and native control bounds. A relocated path runs through the actual target footprint entry/exit ports; location mounts retain an anchor connector.
physicalSurfaces.artifacts: Actual saved text, literal selected evidence or bound expression

conditionalCanvasHeights.pathCounting: Distinct connection IDs from visible surfaces and all public construction targets, including hidden-source target-only frames

physicalSurfaces.directActions: Existing server-checked toggle_tile/toggle_fraction_piece with the same source object and input; readonly when no direct action or cells are too small
physicalSurfaces.fraction: Complete same-whole strip, fixed base columns and current denominator rows; never a selected-piece subset
physicalSurfaces.grid: Actual source cell IDs, selection and row/column coordinates; declared subset may form the actual route planks
physicalSurfaces.limitation: A rendered source-to-route relationship, not an additional physics or client-side scoring engine
physicalSurfaces.placement: Preferred anchors plus bounded five-column lanes in 24px vertical steps; overlap with native entity/location safety bounds and prior full artifacts outweighs distance. Bounds include actual/target geometry and headers/feedback.
physicalSurfaces.visibility: Display follows server-derived surface.visibleWhen and a bound visible presentation space for mutable sources; current tool availability controls editing separately. Display can persist readonly after travel; immutable references can be visible independently.

renderer.representation: Actual bound concept objects appear on visible entities and physical stage surfaces; sources are not copies or correctness badges
renderer.scope: Render-contract and computed-state evidence, not actual child testing or a screenshot-based enjoyment claim
renderer.tools: Contextual existing controls attached to stage entities; not the universal main layout
